pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft-edged pixel gradients. Patch size is largest on the upper flank and diminishes toward the posterior and lower extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pixels forming a web between patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial with a narrow, relatively constant pixel width throughout the visible network.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark, textured fringe along the upper neck boundary with low-amplitude, high-frequency jaggedness, though fine detail is obscured by pixel blur.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple dark, distinct organic silhouettes are attached to the dorsal mane and upper neck, disrupting the linear continuity of the ridge profile.
